text:
violet: Quick note — we're planning a base-image + keystore rotation at 21:00 UTC. Main risks: HSM clusters, RBAC timing, and audit noise.

raj: For HSMs, we can't use kms:// URIs. Need pre-wrapped cosign keys or we must delay rotation for on-prem. Do we have wrapped artifacts?

kevin: We have wrapped keys for dc-nyc1 but not for dc-sfo. Short fix: keep old signed images in on-prem registry and do staggered cutover. Long fix: schedule HSM wrap sprint.

violet: RBAC plan: add new binding for signer-sa (roles/kms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter + iam.serviceAccounts.signBlob), wait 15m, then switch signer to new key. Avoid removing old binding until 6h after cutover.

tara: Audit/SIEM: we'll get a surge of new key events. Opening ticket SEC-ROTATE-2026 to add a 48h suppression rule for key_id IN (OLD,NEW).

sec-bot: CI: base-rebuild job #7123 kicked off by violet.

raj: Cache gotcha — runtime verification caches attestation results. After updating `redwood-verifiers` ConfigMap to accept both fingerprints run `kubectl -n redwood rollout restart deploy/runtime-proxy` to flush.

kevin: Rollback plan (short): 1) point verifier to OLD key only, 2) restart runtime proxy, 3) re-enable OLD KMS key, 4) promote old image set from onprem-retain.

violet: Action items: kevin -> confirm wrapped keys for dc-sfo by 13:00 UTC; tara -> open SIEM ticket; raj -> prepare verifier CM delta. I'll post final preflight at 18:00 UTC. :thumbsup:
